characters.summary: Gonzo the Great is an eccentric performance artist and daredevil who specializes in high-risk stunts, often involving explosions, cannon launches, and musical instruments. He is an alien in Muppets from Space, possesses rubbery physical durability, and is frequently accompanied by his sweetheart, Camilla the Chicken.

mechanisms: Not established by the cited sources

weaknesses: Captured by a government agency in Muppets from Space and had to be rescued
limitations: Lacks conventional superpower offense aside from extreme stunt durability and alien telepathy

sources.supports: General background and stunts on The Muppet Show.
Gonzo is a daredevil performance artist with a long romance with Camilla; an alien in Muppets from Space.

feats.claim: Performs dangerous acts such as being shot out of a cannon and eating rubber tires.

campaignTags.claim: Projects himself into the air via cannons and other stunt equipment
